Should the said planet be in the 6th, 8th or 12th, there will be disease or deformity of eyes. Notes: "Netresa" denotes the lord of the 2nd, i.e. significator of eyes. This does not mean that the 12th lord has nothing to do with eyes. Precisely, 2nd lord and 12th lord respectively lord over right eye and left eye respectively. This is from the health point of view of eye. However, when the beauty of the eyes is to be known, it is from the 2nd house only. Jupiter well placed in the 2nd, or the 2nd lord in exaltation or with a benefice will give one beautiful eyes. While Venus in the 2nd or Full Moon in the 2nd will not deprive one of beautiful e
